_note: Starter reference list. Meanings cross-checked on 2026-10-06 against adinkrasymbols.org (a secondary, commercial website, not a native-speaker or scholarly review): all 13 names/meanings agree in substance. Still verified=false until a cultural adviser reviews. Known wording differences: Akoma (site: love, faithfulness), Aya (site: endurance, perseverance), Nkyinkyim (site: toughness, versatility, dynamism). Sankofa has two forms: the bird looking back with an egg, and the stylised heart. Do not add entries without a source.

symbols.name: Sankofa
symbols.meaning: go back and fetch it; learn from the past
symbols.shape_notes: Bird form: a bird whose head is turned backward over its body, holding an egg in its beak, feet facing forward. It has no stand, pedestal, base, ground line or scrolls beneath it. (Source: written description on adinkrasymbols.org; there is also a separate stylised-heart form with symmetrical spirals: do not mix the two.)

symbols.name: Adinkrahene
symbols.meaning: chief of the Adinkra symbols; greatness, charisma, leadership

symbols.name: Dwennimmen
symbols.meaning: ram's horns; humility together with strength

symbols.name: Funtunfunefu-Denkyemfunefu
symbols.meaning: Siamese crocodiles; democracy, unity in diversity

symbols.name: Nyame Nti
symbols.meaning: by God's grace; faith, trust in God

symbols.name: Duafe

symbols.name: Mate Masie
